concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-general-testing-node]] - collected Node.js general testing reference for Braintree Sandbox fixtures and simulated gateway outcomes, with qualified environment, Production and purge boundaries
warnings: Treat the page as a collected 2026-09-16 Sandbox snapshot, not proof of current availability, Production acceptance, account eligibility or successful payment execution.
Preserve the distinction between amount-driven transaction behavior and card-number- or nonce-driven verification behavior; do not treat a valid test card as a guaranteed successful transaction.
Keep Node.js nonce objects and examples package- and snapshot-qualified; do not attribute them to other SDK variants.
Preserve conditional fraud-tool requirements, the Node 2.24.0 minimum shown for the Risk Threshold rejection reason, the illustrative-only Sandbox UI limit and the deprecated fraud nonce.
Preserve purge consequences: logout, temporary account lock and blocked API operations until completion, along with the page's unaffected-setting and merchant-account deletion limits.
